risk_note: RV1 by path (apps/h5; no money logic). H5 notices and agreements: /notice lists notice-category articles in server order (summary from notice.text, Beijing dates, load-more with in-flight dedupe), /notice?article_id= shows one notice through the shared ArticleBody; /agreement?type= reads GET /v1/articles/<type> (agreement article ids equal the route type; contract wording requested), a missing or unknown type falls back to agreement and never reaches the path; 30701 empty states win over cached data; no H5-drawn title bar. Not built: the pinned tag (no contract field) and the offline bundled copy. Rule tests by Codex in two calls (45 tests; round 2 after the Claude spec-test S1s on an in-page title bar and a ?version= outside routes.json) plus an orchestrator mechanical fix (import.meta.url in source.test), Claude spec-test review 2 rounds pass, red on the test machine (red/2). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round. Test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/1 green; notice chunk about 2.2 KB, agreement chunk about 1.2 KB gzip. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1: tests required an in-page title bar against the H5 no-title-bar rule; S1: ?version= outside routes.json), Codex round 2 fixed both and three S2s; round 2 pass with one S2 (stray ?version= not tested)
